description: Implementation of the StreamingSource class for media streaming in Android, handling TS data parsing, discontinuities, and access units.

classes.name: NuPlayer::StreamingSource
classes.description: Handles streaming media data, parsing TS packets, managing discontinuities, and providing access units.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes stream listener and TS parser, starts listening for data.

methods.name: feedMoreTSData
methods.description: Feeds TS data into parser, handles discontinuities, end of stream, and errors.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves media format information for audio or video.

methods.name: dequeueAccessUnit
methods.description: Dequeues the next available media access unit (frame or packet).
